messages:
alex: Rolling out v2 to 10% in us-west in 10m, canary route. Brief ops eyes please.
deploy-bot: /deploy start --canary 10% --routes v2 -> initiated
sam: Release notes link when ready? need to call out header change for clients
jess: Updating notes now: https://git.internal/docs/releases/v2-api (draft)
pat: Canary telemetry healthy on general latency; token usage looks normal.
alex: we're seeing a small uptick in 429s from mobile UA in eu-west, about +6% in last 5m
sam: which tenant ids affected? any spikes tied to backpressure or auth TTL?
pat: spike concentrated on mobile SDK tenants: tenant_42, tenant_77, tenant_101
dave: can we pin those tenants to v1 via routing header until we triage?
alex: yes, plan: pause canary, pin affected tenants, push header normalization hotfix
deploy-bot: /deploy pause --canary -> canary paused (10%)
jess: pushed hotfix branch that normalizes X-Client-UA header casing; running smoke tests
sam: if hotfix looks good we'll resume to 30% in 20m, otherwise full rollback to v1
pat: created temporary pinlist: /api/v1/pinlist -> tenants [tenant_42,tenant_77,tenant_101]
dave: added route override: route-match header 'X-API-Version: 1' for those tenants
alex: test curl for pin behavior: curl -H 'X-API-Version: 1' https://api.redwood.ai/generate -v
deploy-bot: /deploy status -> canary paused at 10%, 3 pinned tenants
jess: hotfix smoke green on staging; deploying to canary now
sam: ops note: rollback criteria -> sustained 5min 429 increase >5% OR 95th latency >500ms
pat: documented rollback checklist and contact list: https://go/ops/v2-rollback
alex: handing off to night-ops for 04:00-08:00 UTC watch window, will re-evaluate before resume
night-ops: acknowledged. will monitor metrics and paging thresholds, ready to execute rollback
alex: update release notes to include mobile client caveat and pinlist details before resume :memo:
jess: done, pushed release notes update and release log
sam: thanks. keeping this thread closed once stability verified. :thumbsup:
